FULL TEXT:
HARCOURT BUTLER TECHNICAL UNIVESRITY, KANPUR
Tentative Dates for Direct Recruitment to various Teaching/Administrative
Posts
(Advertisement No.1460/HBTU/Estt./01/2026, October 24th2026)
S.
No.
Description of various activities/phases of recruitment
(as applicable for Faculty/Administrative posts)
Dates
1 Date of the Advertisement October 24th2026
2 Last date of receipt of online applications December 8th, 2026, 11.59 pm (Tuesday)
3 Display of Academic Score/API (to invite objections, if
any by the candidates) (7 days-time given to candidates for
inviting objections)*
January 8th2027, 07.00 pm (Friday)
4 Last date of inviting objections on the API score* January 15th2027, 07.00 pm (Friday)
5 Display of Revised/Final Academic Score/API of
candidates after redressal of objections, if any January 19th2027, 07.00 pm (Tuesday)
6 Issue of Online Admit Cards for written test (MCQ) (only
for the eligible candidates to the post of Assistant
Professor and Assistant Workshop Superintendent)*
January 21st2027, 05.00 pm on wards
(Thursday)
7
Date of Written Test* (Objective type/MCQ) (Only for the
post of Assistant Professor and Assistant Workshop
Superintendent)
January 24 2027, Sunday, (12.00-2.00 pm)
Venue: Main Building HBTU Kanpur,
Nawabganj, Kanpur
Pin- 2080002
8 Display of result of the written test (to invite objections, if
any by the candidates) (3-days-time given to candidates) January 25th2026, 11.30 am (Monday)
9 Last date for invitation of objections/grievances, if any on
the written test score January 28th2026, 11.30 am (Thursday)
10 Displayof revised score of written test (after redressal of
objections on test score) January 28th2026, 5.00 pm(Thursday)
11 Display of candidates short-listed for Teaching skills and
Interviews (as applicable for various posts) January 29th2026, 5.00 pm(Friday)
12 Dispatch of Interview letters to shortlisted candidates January 30th2026 (Saturday)
12 Interview schedule (tentative) February 13-18th2027 (6 days) (Saturady-
Thursday)
*All information related to written test would be displayed on the university website
www.hbtu.ac.in under the “Recruitment Link”
**- Any correspondence in regard of this recruitment should be made on the email only
(recruitment2026@hbtu.ac.in)
